reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a level-01 entry that writes GLOBAL or EXTERNAL with the FILLER format or with no entry-name, and must refuse an unnamed/FILLER record description subordinate to an FD that writes EXTERNAL or GLOBAL; named entries in those positions compile.
reader.edition-search: Read ScreenClausePlacement (the DataNameRequired row of ClausePlacementRules.Rules, isFiller = cobolName is null || FILLER at DataBinder.cs:3725) and ScreenFileRecordEntryNames: neither reads DialectLevel, CobolVersion, ConstructRegistry or ReservedWords; Edition.Error is only the diagnostic sink (EditionContext#Error records unconditionally). One arm at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers only an FD IS EXTERNAL with a FILLER record; not exercised: a Working-Storage 01 with EXTERNAL/GLOBAL and FILLER or omitted name, an FD IS GLOBAL with an unnamed record, a FILLER group record after a named one, and the accept half (named entries)

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2404 at (5,8): the EXTERNAL clause is not admitted here - this entry has no data-name
probes.expected: refused: 01 FILLER ... IS EXTERNAL violates SR5

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2404 at (5,8): the GLOBAL clause is not admitted here (implied FILLER)
probes.expected: refused: 01 with omitted name and GLOBAL

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2404 at (10,8): a record description entry of file 'F' has no data-name, and the file description entry contains the GLOBAL clause
probes.expected: refused: FD IS GLOBAL with an unnamed record

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2404 at (11,8) for the second (FILLER group) record of FD F IS EXTERNAL; the named R1 drew nothing
probes.expected: refused only for the FILLER record

probes.printed: EXIT 65, COBOL2404 at (6,8) for 01 FILLER IS GLOBAL group

probes.expected: accepted: named FD GLOBAL records, named EXTERNAL elementary, named GLOBAL group whose subordinates are FILLER/unnamed (SR5 asks only the entry carrying the clause), elementary GLOBAL with VALUE

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.4.3.3 SR5  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: One edition-blind rule row (DataNameRequired) serves the entry half and ScreenFileRecordEntryNames serves the FD-record half; both fire at --std 85 for every form probed. The diagnostic text cites §2023:13.16.3 SR7 even at --std 85 (a citation of the latest edition, not a wrong verdict).

refuter.evidence: x1a FD F IS EXTERNAL with an omitted-name 01 (the reader tried omitted-name only under GLOBAL) -> EXIT 65 COBOL2404 at (10,8); x1b lowercase 'filler ... external' in WS and an omitted-name '01 IS GLOBAL' group in a contained program -> COBOL2404 at (5,8) and (14,8); x1c FD IS EXTERNAL IS GLOBAL with named R1 and a FILLER group record -> COBOL2404 only at (11,8); x1d FILLER record under an FD with neither clause plus named GLOBAL-with-VALUE and EXTERNAL items -> EXIT 0 'ABCXYZ' (the rule asks nothing of a plain FD's records). Read §1985:X.4.6.3 SR1: GLOBAL reaches 01 entries of File/Working-Storage, FDs and RDs; an RD's report-name is mandatory, so no further form is in range. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.4.3.3 SR5  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5'.
